summary: Leaf helper that executes the RDTSC (read timestamp counter) instruction via the __rdtsc intrinsic and writes the 64-bit result into the caller-supplied output pointer a2. The first argument a1 is accepted but never referenced. On the frame path, invoked by the high-resolution timer wrappers (QueryPerformanceCounter mode dispatch, start, accumulate, reset) and by the random-noise table and deterministic hash generators as a timing seed.

operations.description: Execute the RDTSC instruction through the __rdtsc intrinsic to capture the CPU timestamp counter.
Store the 64-bit RDTSC result into the output pointer a2.
On the frame path; called by the timer/QPC wrappers and the noise and hash initializers.
Return without a value; the timestamp is delivered through a2.
